items.title: Riskified surges following 41% Q3 revenue growth and higher outlook
items.summary: Riskified reported $115.2 million in Q3 revenue, up 41% year over year, and raised 2026 revenue guidance to $427–433 million. Shares traded 20.4% higher at 12:37 PM EST. Cash and deposits are strong and free cash flow positive, but gross margin narrowed sharply; merchant retention and agentic-fraud product adoption remain tests.

items.title: India identifies Fujairah Energy tanker strike and four injured crew
items.summary: India's shipping minister said a projectile struck the Liberia-flagged VLCC Fujairah Energy on November 10 while sailing between Al Ruwais and Dubai, injuring four crew. One Indian seafarer had minor injuries and the remaining 18 crew were reported safe. The incident may overlap earlier Gulf tanker warnings; cargo damage and incremental oil throughput loss remain unverified.

items.title: Russian refineries representing 30% of nameplate capacity affected by drone strikes
items.summary: Reuters reported that attacks since late October have disrupted nine major Russian refineries whose combined nameplate capacity represents about 30% of national capacity. This is not a confirmed 30% fall in throughput: industry sources estimate an actual possible crude-processing reduction of up to 200,000 tonnes per day. Repair progress and fuel exports will determine the lasting physical impact.

items.title: UKMTO Warning 202-26 flags another unresolved Hormuz tanker incident
items.summary: Reports of UKMTO Warning 202-26 describe suspicious activity involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with military authorities as the source. The vessel, incident date and time, crew condition, damage and environmental effects are unknown. This is a separate warning from 201-26, but it is neither a confirmed attack nor a verified physical oil-flow loss.

items.title: Talen Energy secures seven-year 750 MW PJM capacity contract with expected $100M annual revenue
items.summary: Talen Energy announced a seven-year agreement covering 750 MW of accredited capacity at Guernsey Power Station, expected to generate approximately $100 million a year beginning in the 2029/30 PJM delivery year. Combined with existing capacity arrangements, these megawatts provide about $1 billion of ten-year capacity-revenue visibility. TLN advanced in morning trading; PJM rules, delivery obligations and operations remain risks.
